We now see adjusted EPS between $7.65 and $7.75 for the full year, up from our prior range of $7.10 to $7.25.
Finally, we now expect free cash flow to be between $9 and $9.2 billion for the full year, up from our prior range of $8.5 to $8.75 billion, driven primarily by IEEPA recovery.

With respect to operating profit, we now expect growth between $475 and $525 million versus 2025, up from our prior expectation of between $275 and $350 million, driven by the drop-through on increased sales volume and approximately $170 million of IEEPA recovery.
